messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["eagle", "octopus"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature is a large brown bird of prey standing in profile facing right. It has the head, hooked beak, feathered body, folded wings, and yellow taloned feet of an eagle, covered in dense brown plumage. From its rear underside where a tail would be hangs a cluster of long tapering octopus-like tentacles lined with pale suckers, and patches of suckered octopus-like skin are also visible among the feathers on its lower body and thighs.", "extra_limb_pieces": 7, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown feathered eagle head with fierce brow", "part": "head", "where": "top front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "sharply hooked beak, yellow at the base and dark gray at the tip", "part": "beak", "where": "front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "round golden-brown eye with dark pupil", "part": "eye", "where": "side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "folded wings covered in layered brown feathers darker toward the tips", "part": "wings", "where": "on both sides of the body"}, {"looks_like": "thick short legs densely covered in brown feathers", "part": "legs", "where": "under the lower body"}, {"looks_like": "yellow scaly bird feet with toes tipped with long curved black talons", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "short dark brown pointed feather tips", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body above the tentacles"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering brown octopus-like arms lined with pale circular suckers and curling at the tips", "part": "tentacles", "where": "hanging from the rear underside where a tail would be"}, {"looks_like": "dense brown plumage varying from golden-brown on head and legs to darker scalloped covert feathers", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the head, neck, body, wings and upper legs"}, {"looks_like": "patches of bumpy skin with white-ringed circular suckers like an octopus", "part": "markings", "where": "on the lower sides of the body and thighs among the feathers"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
